name: Lichtspiel Wrapped
author: Lichtspiel
description: A look back at the year for each person on its own page in the left menu: hours watched, movies and episodes, favourite genres, most watched shows, longest binge, busiest month, first and last title of the year. It counts what is finished from the moment it is switched on (titles marked as watched by hand do not count). Each person sees only their own year.
